pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Browne, 10.O-O-O Nbd7 11.Qg3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White's g4-g5 with the pawn still on g2. Rewrote it: ...Rg8 guards the undefended g7-pawn against Qg3 (first wording rejected by reviewer, revised and accepted).

pages.name: Danish Gambit Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nc3 with Black's pawn on c3; plan 3 was vague; plan 4 named bare squares (f6, e7). Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Danish Gambit Accepted, Classical  Defence
pages.notes: Overview spoke of White's 'fearsome bishop pair' after both dark-squared bishops were traded; plan 2 proposed the impossible ...dxc3 (it is ...dxc4); plan 1 talked of powerful bishops and queenside castling. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2 around ...dxc4, f6xg7 and the open e-file (theory: unclear).

pages.name: Danish Gambit Accepted: Classical Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ng5 from g1. Rewrote plan 1 around 6.Nc3, Nf3 and Qb3; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Center Game: Paulsen Attack Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an impossible g4-h5 route; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (Nc3, Bd2, O-O-O, f3-g4-h4; ...Nf6, ...Bb4, castling, rook to e8 against e4); British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: 2... g6?
pages.notes: Plan 3 suggested Qh5, which ...g6 covers, and named bare squares. Rewrote it: 3.d4 exd4 4.Qxd4 hits h8 on the open long diagonal. British spelling in plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: McDonnell Gambit, McDonnell Double Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Rf1-f3-g3 lift with the rook still on h1. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 3 and 4.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Pratt Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...O-O though Black has castled, and called the c4-pawn strong. Rewrote around ...Re8+, ...Qxf6/...g6 (a claim of pressure on f2 was rejected by the reviewer, since d4 blocks the diagonal, and removed).

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Stein Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Rf1-f3-g3 lift with the rook on h1; plan 3 suggested queenside castling and a pawn storm. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (c5-bishop covers g1, drive it back with c3 and d4); British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: 3.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote 0-0 and castled without Nf3; plan 3 had the g1-knight going to e3 via f1. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (Nb1-d2-f1-g3/e3 manoeuvre); British spelling in overview and plans 2 and 4.
